correctness.rationale: Direct run-composition counting gives signed conditional masses and an exact odd-even normalization identity. Dividing adjacent odd switch-count laws yields a nonnegative quadratic strictly decreasing in |S|, which establishes likelihood-ratio and stochastic orders. A Bernoulli uniform coupling orders switch counts as p increases; strictness follows at all nontrivial thresholds from the positive chance of zero versus one switch. Every endpoint is handled. The standalone checker reproduces 4,906 exact rational assertions for n=2..14; the all-n proof is analytic.
